title: PORT-BRANCH-agent-zero-minutes-2: carry agent/zero-minutes-2 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `agent/zero-minutes-2` at bc53a6cd99 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: seed/worker/src/executor.js, seed/worker/src/index.js, seed/worker/src/lane.js, seed/worker/test/executor.test.js)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/agent/zero-minutes-2 is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 3 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for agent/zero-minutes-2
